feature_sets.name: Process Resource Consumption Profile
feature_sets.rationale: Measures computational intensity and memory footprint to identify abnormal resource monopolization, typical in cryptomining or heavy data compression.

feature_sets.name: Local State Modification and Data Access
feature_sets.rationale: Captures the extent of local state modification and data access, highlighting excessive data staging, persistence mechanisms, or configuration changes.

feature_sets.name: TCP Communication Volume and Directionality
feature_sets.rationale: Monitors the volume and directionality of network interactions to identify potential data exfiltration or active command and control channels.

quality.summary: The dataset provides excellent OS-level behavioral signals including CPU, memory, registry, and network metrics. Graph topology is strong with clear lineage, host, user, and executable image resolution.
limitations: Network destinations are aggregated and lack specific remote IP/port visibility.
File target paths for I/O operations are missing, preventing file-access graphs.

graph_relations.meaning: Represents network communication from source IP to destination IP.
Links a source endpoint to the destination port it accessed.

feature_sets.name: Payload Size and Transmission Throughput
feature_sets.rationale: Measures volume of data exchanged and transmission speeds.

feature_sets.name: TCP Handshake and Packet Timing
feature_sets.rationale: Analyzes round-trip times and packet arrival delays.

feature_sets.name: Historical Connection Frequency Context
feature_sets.rationale: Evaluates recent connection counts to spot scanning or targeting.

quality.summary: Detailed flow timing, throughput, and frequency counts with clear 0-based column index mappings provided.
limitations: No host-level processes or user identities available.

graph_relations.meaning: Links a distinct network flow observation to the destination port it accessed.

selected_columns.reason: Measures outbound payload size, useful for detecting data exfiltration.
Measures inbound payload size, indicating response volume or downloaded files.
Captures the transmission throughput in bytes per second.
Captures the packet throughput, highlighting rapid scanning or brute-force behavior.
Indicates the total lifespan of the connection.
Measures the average time between consecutive packets, highlighting rhythmic automated patterns.
Captures the average time a connection sits idle before more data is sent, typical of beaconing.
Captures the average time a connection is actively transferring data.
Indicates connection termination attempts.
Indicates connection establishment attempts, useful for identifying SYN floods or port scans.
Indicates forcefully rejected connections.
Indicates pushed payloads, common in data transfers and some exploits.
Indicates packet acknowledgments, establishing communication continuity.

feature_sets.name: Network Flow Volume and Throughput
feature_sets.rationale: Measures the physical size and transmission speed of data to detect heavy downloads, data exfiltration, or denial-of-service floods.

feature_sets.name: Flow Lifecycle and Inter-Packet Timing
feature_sets.rationale: Analyzes the temporal footprint of the flow to identify automated long-lived beaconing, C2 heartbeat rhythms, or stealthy low-and-slow scanning.

feature_sets.name: TCP Flag and Handshake Analysis
feature_sets.rationale: Evaluates the distribution of TCP control flags to spot anomalous handshake behavior, port scanning techniques, or disrupted communication.

quality.summary: The dataset contains deep, highly descriptive statistical features for analyzing flow behavior, timing, and TCP flags. However, it completely lacks IP addresses, hostnames, and timestamps, preventing meaningful sessionization and severely limiting graph construction to just flow-to-port connections.
limitations: No source or destination IP addresses are present, making endpoint graphs impossible.
No timestamps are provided, preventing temporal ordering and sessioning.
Many column names contain inconsistent leading whitespace.
